th.btn: How to recognise a TH / STH
th.title: Treasure Hunt guide
th.g.1: Regular Treasure Hunt (2013 onwards): a small flame-in-a-circle logo on the car, and often a silver flame symbol behind the car on the card.
th.g.2: Super Treasure Hunt (since 2007): usually Spectraflame paint and Real Riders rubber tyres, a TH logo on the car (sometimes on the back) and often a gold symbol behind the car on the card.
th.g.3: Check the card: year, series position and collector number must match the release (for example 82/250).
th.g.4: Shiny paint or rubber tyres alone do not prove a Super. Wheels can be swapped and cars can be repainted or customised.
th.g.5: Older Treasure Hunts follow the rules of their own year; a 1998 car cannot be a Super. Look the year up before deciding.
th.g.6: If unsure, photograph the base, sides, wheels and packaging and compare with a reliable reference before paying a high price.
th.src: Summary of public collector guides. Details can differ by year, so always confirm online.
